subject: External assessment onboarding and access plan (scope update + schedule)
raw_messages:
From: PenTest Labs <hello@pentestlabs.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: External assessment for Redwood Inference - scope & prelim questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for choosing PenTest Labs for the upcoming external assessment. To get the engagement scheduled and minimize back-and-forth, a few quick items we need from your side:

1) Confirm scope: public web portal (https://app.redwood.com), API gateway (api.redwood.com), and authentication flows. Are there any additional assets you want in-scope (mobile APIs, partner integrations)?

2) Preferred testing window: we recommend off-peak nights (US PST) July 12–16. Can you confirm availability (start time / blackout periods)?

3) Access model: we typically test against staging for active exploitation and request limited, time-bound production smoke tests for auth/SSO flows. Please confirm whether you can provide:
   - Jumpbox (bastion) access with temporary accounts
   - Test accounts (user roles) with sample data

4) Point us to your asset inventory and a contact for SOC2/Legal approvals (if production access required).

I’ve attached our rules-of-engagement (PTL_RoE_v2.pdf) and a sample vulnerability report template (vuln_report_template.docx) for your review.

If helpful, Alicia Gomez (cc) will be our engagement manager and can jump on a 30-min sync to finalize the SOW and schedule.

Best,

Alicia Gomez
Engagement Manager | PenTest Labs
agomez@pentestlabs.io | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: PTL_RoE_v2.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)]
[Attachment: vuln_report_template.docx (DOCX, 85 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: PenTest Labs <hello@pentestlabs.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: External assessment for Redwood Inference - scope & prelim questions

Hi Alicia / PenTest team,

Thanks — we’re ready to proceed. A few quick answers:

- Current in-scope (confirm): public web portal (app.redwood.com) and API gateway (api.redwood.com). We also need you to evaluate our mobile API endpoints — see the mobile API list in the asset inventory link below.
- Preferred window: July 12–16 nights (starting 22:00 PST). Production smoke tests are allowed but will need SOC sign-off; we can run them for up to 2 hours on the first and last day.
- Access: we will provide a jumpbox with temporary accounts and a set of test users (including admin and standard roles).

Shared asset inventory: https://drive.google.com/redwood/asset-inventory-v1

I’ve attached the CSV of assets for quick reference.

Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: asset_inventory_v1.csv (CSV, 47 KB)]

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@pentestlabs.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: PenTest Labs <hello@pentestlabs.io>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: External assessment for Redwood Inference - scope & prelim questions

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Marissa. A couple follow-ups:

1) Mobile APIs: can you confirm the base URL(s) and whether the APIs sit behind the same API gateway (api.redwood.com) or a dedicated mobile gateway? Any OAuth/OIDC details we should know about?

2) Production smoke tests: noted. For production tests we require a short SOC-approved exception and prefer a supervised window. Please advise who will sign the approval.

3) Access details: for the jumpbox we generally need an SSH public key and temporary account names; for test accounts, ideally a CSV of username/password pairs (or SAML test accounts).

Proposed engagement timeline:
- Pre-engagement checks and access provisioning: Jul 6–9
- Active testing: Jul 12–16 (nights)
- Draft report: Jul 20
- Final report + remediation call: Jul 27

We will update the SOW to include mobile API testing and send it back for signature.

Thanks,

Alicia
Alicia Gomez | Engagement Manager, PenTest Labs
[Attachment: PTL_SoW_Redwood_draft.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@pentestlabs.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: External assessment for Redwood Inference - scope & prelim questions

Alicia — quick note on access and constraints from infra/security:

- We can provide a hardened jumpbox in our staging VPC. Temporary user accounts will be provisioned via our IdP and will expire automatically after 48 hours.
- Production smoke tests will require a one-time SOC approval; I can start the approval workflow but will need a sign-off from Soojin (CISO) to allow any live-prod test.
- For SSH access we will accept public keys only (no password auth). Please send the keys for the temporary accounts.

I’ve attached the access matrix showing which hosts/services will be reachable from the jumpbox and the maximum test windows per host.

Markus
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
[Attachment: access_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 65 KB)]

Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: External assessment for Redwood Inference - scope & prelim questions

Thanks Markus/Alicia — one more update from product: we want to explicitly include the mobile auth endpoints and the web portal SSO callback endpoints in the active testing scope.

To be explicit:
- Scope addition: mobile API endpoints (mobile-api.redwood.com) and SSO callback URIs for the web portal.
- Testing constraint: active exploitation to occur in staging only; lightweight authenticated smoke tests (login/logout, token refresh) may run in production under supervision for <= 2 hours on the agreed days.

Please update the SOW to reflect these changes. I’ve attached a short PDF describing the scope change for traceability. Also adding the HubSpot deal id for our procurement process: DEAL-8732.

Marissa
[Attachment: redwood_scope_change_20260702.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)]

Marissa — thanks for the clear scope update. We’ve revised the SoW to include: mobile API endpoints, SSO callback endpoints, and the agreed production smoke-test constraints. Key changes:

- Active exploitation: staging environment only (except supervised production auth smoke tests for up to 2 hours on start/end dates).
- Access: jumpbox with SSH key-only auth; IdP-temporary accounts required.
- Timeline (final): Pre-engagement provisioning Jul 6–9; Testing Jul 12–16; Draft report Jul 20; Final report Jul 27.

Attached: PTL_SoW_Redwood_20260702.pdf — please review and sign using the DocuSign link when ready.

We will also require a small set of test user credentials and the SSH public keys by Jul 9 to keep the schedule.

Best,

Alicia
